cases.explain: The genitive case follows the noun it modifies, showing possession or relationship.
The verb водит (leads) takes the direct object овец in the accusative case.
The preposition на (upon/on) with location takes the prepositional case; plural форм Херувимах.

cases.sentence: Боже, восстанови нас! Да воссияет ___ Твое.
cases.explain: The verb воссияет (will shine) takes the nominative subject лицо.

cases.sentence: О Господь, Бог сил, как долго еще будешь гневаться на молитвы своего ___?
cases.explain: The genitive case follows молитвы to show possession or belonging.

cases.sentence: Из Египта ты перенес виноградную ___, изгнал народы и посадил ее.
cases.explain: The verb перенес (brought) takes the direct object лозу in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Горы покрылись ее ___, и могучие кедры ее ветвями.
cases.explain: The verb покрылись (were covered) takes the instrumental case for what covers.
The verb разрушил (broke down) takes the direct object ограду in the accusative case.

reading.ru: Услышь нас, пастырь Израиля, ты, который водит Иосифа, как овец.
reading.question: Who is being addressed and what is their role?
options: The Shepherd of Israel who leads Joseph like sheep
A prophet who speaks God's word
reading.correct: The Shepherd of Israel who leads Joseph like sheep
reading.explain: The address is to the 'пастырь Израиля' (Shepherd of Israel) who leads Joseph (descendants) like sheep.

reading.ru: Напитал Ты нас слезами, как хлебом, напоил нас ими сполна.
reading.question: What has God given his people to consume?
options: Tears, as if they were bread
reading.correct: Tears, as if they were bread
reading.explain: The passage poetically states God has fed them 'слезами, как хлебом' — tears as if they were bread.

reading.ru: Из Египта ты перенес виноградную лозу, изгнал народы и посадил ее.
reading.question: What did God bring out of Egypt and plant?
options: A grapevine, after driving out nations
reading.correct: A grapevine, after driving out nations
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states 'перенес виноградную лозу' and 'изгнал народы и посадил ее' — brought a grapevine and planted it.

reading.ru: Горы покрылись ее тенью, и могучие кедры ее ветвями.
reading.question: What demonstrated the vine's great growth?
options: Its shadow covered mountains and its branches covered mighty cedars
Its roots went deep into the earth
reading.correct: Its shadow covered mountains and its branches covered mighty cedars
reading.explain: The text describes growth so vast that 'горы покрылись ее тенью' and the 'кедры ее ветвями' — mountains and cedars were covered.

reading.ru: Для чего разрушил ты ее ограды, так что все проходящие мимо обрывают ее плоды?
reading.question: Why is God questioned about breaking down the vine's walls?
options: Because now anyone passing by can pluck its fruit
reading.correct: Because now anyone passing by can pluck its fruit
reading.explain: Breaking the walls resulted in 'все проходящие мимо обрывают ее плоды' — all who pass pluck its fruit.

reading.ru: Боже, восстанови нас! Да воссияет лицо Твое, и будем спасены!
reading.question: What is the repeated plea in this psalm?
options: Restore us and let Your face shine so we will be saved
reading.correct: Restore us and let Your face shine so we will be saved
reading.explain: This refrain requests 'восстанови нас' and 'Да воссияет лицо Твое, и будем спасены' — restore us and let Your face shine.
